killedBy: live status announcements (issue #629) forgets the transition across a gap in gameplay
why: Keeps the diff state across a gap in gameplay, so returning to the menu and starting a different level reads as an advance from wherever the last session stopped -- and an owed death announcement, belonging to a session that has ended, is spoken against the new one's life count. `setStatus(null)` is the HUD's own word for leaving gameplay, which makes it the honest place to forget.
